Former CIA officer Mike Baker talks with Rogan in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience about the UFO whistleblower claims that hit Congress and the news. Baker spent years in covert work before moving into private security, and he judges such claims with a spy's habits.

He weighs what a real disclosure would look like against what the public has actually been shown. Rogan pushes on crash stories, hidden programs, and why officials speak in careful hints. Baker answers with tradecraft logic: who benefits, what can be checked, and what stays fog. The segment is a cool-headed take on a hot story.
